message: さっちんのラブラブ大作戦　終幕

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yoohoo」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sorry I'm thirty minutes late~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I bought a chocolate bar to make up for it~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Umm. Well. If you don't want it, I'm gonna eat it~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「What's wrong? You're acting kinda weird~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Could it be... you actually went ahead and forced the issue?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whaaat! Really? Really, really, really?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Really」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whoa. Whoa~. Whoaaa~. What happened, what happened? Did it just sort of happen? Was it an accident?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...I was looking at his sleeping face, and... well...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whoa-whoaaa! Amazing, Nana-chan! You've already surpassed me, your master!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Surpassed you... Seriously, you...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「There's nothing left for me to teach you~. Actually, let me call you Master~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't... have to」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I see~. So you went and forced yourself on him~. Amaaazing」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I wouldn't say forced...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Forced or not, all's well that ends well~. Even someone as dense and blockheaded as Synn-kun will start noticing you now~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-You think so...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If you're still worried, give it one more push right now~. Create an even bigger fait accompli~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Something even bigger...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「A-Anything beyond this is so embarrassing that even I hesitate to say it~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「But it's for my best friend~. I'll do my best!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Urk... *gulp*」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Next up, sneaking into bed at night, right!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like hell I could do that!」
